transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining today's curriculum review meeting. As you know, we're here to finalize the plan for replacing our seventh-grade humanities materials for the 2026-2027 school year. Before I can close this meeting and record the final settlement, I need to hear a report from each participating school function regarding its implementation requirements. I have the draft plan in front of me — the Pathways Grade 6 edition, 80 printed copies, English-only materials, shared classroom-code digital access, one teacher workshop on August 12, and a student launch on August 17, 2026. I also note that our incoming seventh-grade cohort is expected to be 96 students across the participating schools. Please go ahead and present your function's requirements one at a time, and I'll take note of any revisions needed before we finalize.

transcript.text: Thank you, Dr. Brooks. As Human-Resources Liaison, I need to report a critical requirement. I've confirmed from the current teacher work agreement that implementation requires two paid preparation sessions — on August 10 and August 12, 2026 — and that the earliest compliant student launch date is August 24, 2026. I have not yet entered those dates in the curriculum rollout calendar. This means the draft plan's single workshop on August 12 and the proposed student launch on August 17, 2026 are not sufficient under the agreement. We need to add the August 10 preparation session and move the student launch to August 24, 2026 to be compliant.
